scope: Exactly 2026 regular-season Weeks1-7; actual materialization requires root GO. No model, forecast, outcome or score is opened by this preparation.
annual_source: Authenticated unchanged normalized originals; all source ordinals and rejection reasons retained.
changed_admission: Only rejection set {invalid_american_odds} may newly enter the statistical-line lane. Every other rejection, ambiguous identity/event, duplicate and source condition remains in force.
line_selection: Within each book, earliest retained naive collector snapshot; valid coherent same-line paired-price main-line preference, then deterministic line and original ordinal. Across books use fixed68->69->79 priority.
price_rule: Never replace invalid prices. One-sided or suspect prices retain exact raw values and missing opposite sides. Market/EV eligibility remains false in this line-only loader.
source_fallback: Annual named-book line when available for an opportunity; otherwise recorded DK line from the full available W4-7 archive. Preserve source/timing/contract strata, especially W1-5 versusW6-7 and any W4/5fallback.
site_primary: Recorded line_from=dk only; label jurisdiction and quote timing unknown. Do not call its label authenticated NJ sportsbook pricing.
site_secondary: line_from=sleeper is separately retained contest-threshold evidence, not sportsbook prices. Site-generated ours lines are excluded. Original historical saved lean tables including Sleeper remain unchanged.
site_population: Every supported finite recorded prop; never filter by original lean, highlight, outcome, projected value or late flag. Preserve all flags and rejected rows for coverage.
site_identity: Caller must authenticate an exact source-only GSIS/Sleeper/event crosswalk generated by the existing source-qualified identity adapter. Exact original team, opponent, position and kickoff must match. No names or current-team guesses.
timing: Retrospective timing-unverified lines only. Collector/save time is not quote time or pregame proof. The declared numerical reconstruction cutoff does not authenticate quote availability at that cutoff.
contracts: Statistical threshold direction only, venue settlement unavailable. Preserve half/integer and signed statistic definitions. No target/chart market invented.
anytime_TD: Retain source noside/value0 as a separate event offer, never numeric Over/Under0; source event rule remains unverified and absent No side stays absent.
reused_code: Unmodified historical_market_archive normalization output and historical_market_comparison.crossing_mask for valid actual-price coherence; new versioned line-only canonicalization changes admission explicitly, not old results.
production: Research-only; no producer dispatch or website mutation.
